prompt: A photograph of a pet sitter and a golden retriever relaxing together on a cream linen sofa in a bright living room. The sitter, seen from the shoulders down and turned slightly toward the dog, wears a soft oatmeal knit sweater and rests one hand gently on the dog's back; the dog lies calm and content with its head on a cushion, ears relaxed. Warm window light from the left, gentle long shadows across the cushions, a shallow depth of field with the dog in sharp focus. The sofa and the two figures fill the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is an even, plain warm cream wall with nothing on it. Palette: cream, warm sand, soft oatmeal and one muted terracotta cushion. Natural, unposed and affectionate, shot on a 50mm lens.
